result.title: Neural Stochastic Forecasting for Lateral Molecular Diffusion Simulations
result.summary: Predicting the long-time diffusion of membrane proteins is challenging because molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are computationally expensive, while experimental single-particle tracking is often limited by finite observation times. Here, we introduce a neural stochastic (NS) model for forecasting the collective diffusion of membrane proteins from coarse-grained MD trajectories. The model combines a transformer-based representation of protein configurations, recurrent networks operating at multiple temporal scales, and a stochastic latent process with learned memory. A cross-attention decoder then generates correlated protein displacements while accounting for the instantaneous system geometry and periodic boundary conditions. We evaluate the model in two membrane systems: seven interacting PIEZO channels and a mixed system containing seven PIEZO and ten TREK channels. For the seven PIEZO system, the NS model reproduces the anomalous diffusion exponent measured in MD simulations $α\sim 1$, substantially improving on a previously developed variational autoregressive model that exhibits superdiffusive behavior. The model also generates trajectories extending to 40,000 frames and captures the distinct diffusion characteristics of PIEZO and TREK populations in the mixed system. Comparisons of time-averaged mean-square displacements, Van Hove displacement distributions, and non-Gaussian parameters show that the model preserves key statistical features of the simulated dynamics. These results establish neural stochastic modeling as a promising approach for generating long trajectories of multi-protein membrane diffusion and extending the statistical analysis of molecular dynamics simulations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出神经随机（NS）模型，用 transformer 编码粗粒化 MD 的蛋白构型、多时间尺度循环网络与带学习记忆的随机隐过程建模演化，再由 cross-attention 解码器在几何与周期边界条件下生成相互关联的蛋白位移，用于长时膜蛋白集合扩散的预测与统计评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「随机隐过程＋多尺度记忆更新＋条件解码」的长程状态推演与分布统计检验方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的持续更新、长程 rollout 稳定性与生成结果评估提供方法线索；但该隐状态是否承载可复用的任务相关信息尚待核查，与视觉多模态推理的直接联系较弱。
